name: Investor Permanent Residence ("Golden Visa", VNZh za investitsii)

requirement_groups.name: Investment in an existing Russian company

requirements.blocker_text: Requires investment of at least RUB 30,000,000 in a Russian company that has operated for at least 3 years, combined with taxes, fees, and insurance contributions from that investment of at least RUB 6,000,000 paid in the year preceding the application (or RUB 4,000,000/year sustained over 2 years), under Government Resolution No. 2573 of 31 December 2022.
requirements.fix_path: Structure a qualifying RUB 30,000,000 investment in an established Russian company meeting the tax/contribution thresholds.

requirement_groups.name: Investment in a socially significant regional project

requirements.blocker_text: Requires investment of at least RUB 15,000,000 within the 3 years preceding the application in a socially significant regional development project, under Government Resolution No. 2573.
requirements.fix_path: Structure a qualifying RUB 15,000,000 investment in a designated regional project within the 3-year window.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires real estate in Moscow with a combined cadastral value of at least RUB 50,000,000, purchased at the construction stage or within 2 years of completion -- no other property type qualifies.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying Moscow real estate meeting the RUB 50,000,000 cadastral-value threshold.

requirement_groups.name: Real estate investment, Far Eastern Federal District

requirements.blocker_text: Requires real estate in the Far Eastern Federal District with a combined cadastral value of at least RUB 20,000,000 -- the lowest of the three regional real-estate tiers, a deliberate incentive for investment in Russia's Far East.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying Far Eastern Federal District real estate meeting the RUB 20,000,000 cadastral-value threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires real estate outside Moscow and the Far Eastern Federal District with a combined cadastral value of at least RUB 25,000,000.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying real estate in an eligible region meeting the RUB 25,000,000 cadastral-value threshold.

evidence_required.document: Investment or property-purchase documentation meeting the applicable track's threshold
Tax and social-contribution payment records (business/regional tracks)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: as of a late 2025/early 2026 legal update, the previous requirement to spend 6 months per year in Russia to maintain investor VNZh status was eliminated

sources.title: Dvitex (real-estate law firm) -- Золотая виза в Россию за инвестиции в недвижимость, citing Government Resolution No. 2573 of 31 December 2022 and its investment criteria in full
Forbes Russia -- За два года действия в России «золотых виз» за ними обратились 40 инвесторов, reporting real uptake figures and the compressed 6-month processing timeline

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. STRUCTURAL FINDING, a real and notably low-uptake figure worth surfacing rather than glossing over: per Forbes Russia, only 40 investors applied for this route in its first two years of operation -- a strikingly small number relative to comparable investor-residency programmes elsewhere in this dataset (contrast with Saudi Arabia's or Italy's investor-visa volumes), suggesting either limited awareness, a narrow target population, or broader friction in practice despite the programme's stated benefits. Grants a genuinely fast conversion: the investor route compresses the ordinary 1.5-year VNZh timeline down to roughly 6 months, and skips the RVP stage entirely (pr_after_months = 0), directly comparable in shape to ru_hqs_status's own RVP-skip. A significant regulatory liberalisation is confirmed independently across sources checked in this research pass: a late-2025/early-2026 legal update eliminated the prior requirement that investor-VNZh holders spend at least 6 months per year physically in Russia to maintain status -- making the programme viable for investors who want the legal status without relocating full-time, a meaningful design choice worth flagging since it's the opposite direction of several other countries' investor-visa reforms in this dataset (which have generally tightened rather than loosened physical-presence rules). HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of a government resolution-hosting site (pravo.gov.ru or publication.pravo.gov.ru) was achieved for Resolution No. 2573 itself in this research pass; both sources are tier-3 but the specific figures (RUB 15M/30M/6M/4M for business tracks, RUB 50M/20M/25M regional real-estate tiers) are stated with enough legal-citation precision and structural consistency to be treated as reliable, flagged as a tier-1 upgrade target for a follow-up session. citizenship_after_months (36) reflects a materially faster track than the general work-based pipeline (see ru_naturalisation for the full breakdown of Russia's citizenship timelines by category).
